meta.title: MCG — Georgian Wine & Spirits Export
meta.description: MCG connects Georgian wine and spirits producers to international markets through expert export management, import sourcing, and brand marketing.

hero.headline: Wine, spirits, and a proven route to market.
hero.subtext: MCG is led by Levan Kurdadze, an international trade consultant with 10+ years and 31 partnerships secured across 16 markets. We help producers enter and grow in export markets, from first strategy to active sales.

services.heading: What We Do
services.subheading: End-to-end trade and marketing support, led by someone who has done it at scale. From export operations to brand positioning, MCG works as an extension of your team.

cards.title: Export Operations
cards.description: Full-cycle export management — logistics coordination, documentation, customs compliance, and buyer relationship management across 15+ markets.

cards.title: Import & Sourcing
cards.description: Strategic sourcing and in-market representation for international companies entering Georgia. Levan has represented a US manufacturer end to end, from market research and partner identification through to signed distribution.

cards.title: Brand & Marketing
cards.description: Market positioning, brand development, trade event representation, and promotional strategy tailored to international buyers and distributors.

cards.title: Trade Consulting
cards.description: Market entry analysis, regulatory guidance, distributor identification, and commercial negotiation support for producers at any stage of internationalisation.

about.heading: Led by Levan Kurdadze
about.body: Levan Kurdadze is an international trade and export-import consultant with over ten years driving market entry for Georgian producers. As Export Manager and Partner Relations Development Manager at Tbilvino, one of Georgia's leading wineries, he attracted 24 new partner companies across 16 countries and generated over 7 million GEL in export revenue (33% net profit), opening markets including Ukraine, the Baltics, Turkey, China, France, Poland, the UAE, the USA, and Japan. In 2025, the UN Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) appointed him National Trade and Marketing Consultant to lead a value-chain analysis and export-diversification strategy for Georgia's wine sector. He has represented producers at 15+ international trade fairs, including Vinexpo Paris, Prowein Shanghai, CIIE Shanghai, FOODEX Tokyo, and IWSE Seoul. He holds dual master's degrees in International Business Management (Georgia and Spain) and is a Certified Export Manager (Enterprise Georgia), fluent in English and Russian.

process.heading: How We Work
process.subheading: A structured approach from first conversation to active market presence.

phases.title: Market Assessment
phases.description: We analyse target markets, identify the right entry points, and map the competitive landscape for your product category.

phases.title: Strategy & Planning
phases.description: We define the route to market, pricing structure, positioning, and a realistic timeline based on your capacity and goals.

phases.title: Market Entry
phases.description: We activate distributor and buyer relationships, manage documentation and logistics, and represent your brand at the point of entry.

phases.title: Growth & Development
phases.description: We monitor performance, support marketing activity in-market, and identify opportunities to expand volume and territory.

markets.heading: Our Network
markets.subheading: The founding team's established relationships span 15 countries across Europe, Asia, and North America.

cta_band.heading: Ready to Enter New Markets?
cta_band.subtext: Tell us where you want to go. We'll tell you how to get there.

footer.tagline: Georgian Wine & Spirits. Connected to the World.
